# Brianne Wakefield (R): NYS Senate, District 4

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Brianne Wakefield's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://www.wakefieldforsenate.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Opponent: [Monica Martinez](../martinez-monica/) (D).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/wakefield-brianne> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

A short biography page for a first-time candidate. Her county trafficking subcommittee role is reported in local press; the other details rest on the campaign's word.

1. Her role chairing the Suffolk County Women's Advisory Commission's Human and Sex Trafficking Subcommittee is reported by the Messenger (May 2026), which quotes her.
2. Church founding, arts board service and family details have no independent record.
